notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Hi :)

The game is now working again! I'm so sorry for not having seen this earlier. 

What happened is that the URL associated with the db no longer exists. I switched everything to a new URL and added some performance improvements to the game. 

Peace & Love,
Patrick

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:

Please let me know if you encounter any more bugs, have feedback or suggestions here. 

Peace & Love,

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi! :)

This patch brings a few minor fixes that were brought to my attention by Psyringe. 


 16:10 resolutions now have a proper fullscreen
 Texts in the options menu will no longer be cut off when having increased text size in Windows settings.
 Added a few more words to the autocorrect that were falsely being corrected before.
If you encounter any more bugs or have any feedback, please report it here on the Steam discussions. 

And if you like the experience, please leave a review so more people will be able to discover it. <3

Peace & Love,
Patrick

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi! :)

I fixed a bug that would only show you newly accepted confessions when starting the game for the second time after I had approved new confessions. 

Luckily I caught this today already and it will only concern a few people. So, if you've played Confessions yesterday, started it up again today and saw the prompt "x new confessions available" before this patch was released it would be best to delete all files in this folder:

C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Roaming\Confessions

This means you will encounter some of the previously read confessions again. I apologize for the inconvenience. 

I've also added a few simple achievements for reading confessions since I figured people would be asking  for it anyways. ^^

Thank you so far to everyone who has been leaving confessions! :)

If you encounter any more bugs or have any feedback, please report it here on the Steam discussions. 

And if you like the experience, please leave a review so more people will be able to discover it. <3

Peace & Love,
Patrick

notes.title: Playtest #1 Update #3
notes.content:
Just a small update this time:

Fixed some problematic code that could have caused crashes on first startup
Added a notification when hovering over READ that it is currently deactivated (after I got one too many insults that it's not working...)

To everyone who had experienced a crash on first startup: 

Could you please (after downloading the latest update) delete the following folder and then start the game again. Let me know if you still experience the crash. I couldn't reproduce it on my end but I hope I found all potential causes for it. 

C:/Users/USERNAME/AppData/Roaming/Confessions

Some more numbers: 191 people have been granted access to the playtest and we're now at 23 confessions. Keep it going! :)

Peace & Love,
Patrick

notes.title: Playtest #1 Update #2
notes.content:
Update time!

Updated "submit" sfx
New background music for WRITE section
New Option: autocorrect as suggested by EvolGrinZ! <3
Fixed some bugs where you were able to click on invisible buttons.

I'm aware the options screen is currently not that attractive but I will sort that out once we have all the options in. ^^

Some more numbers: 182 people have been granted access to the playtest and we're now at 20 confessions. Keep it going! :)

Peace & Love,
Patrick

notes.title: Playtest #1 Update #1
notes.content:
First of all: thank you to everyone who has submitted one or more confessions already! If the quality keeps up being this high this is gonna be an amazing experience! :)

I fixed a few little things this morning: 

"We hear you... start typing." can no longer be accidentally submitted as a confession.
It's no longer possible to click the "next page"-button after submitting a confession without having filled up the whole page.
Fixed a bug where the "submit"-button would stay grey after switching pages.
Added the option to press ESC to got back to the title screen.

Out of the 150 people who have now access to the playtest, 7 confessions have been submitted. We are gonna need a lot more confessions before this can be released. So be prepared for the game to be released a bit later than December most probably. 

Peace & Love,
Patrick
